note: Draft gold rules for City of Toronto Zoning By-law 569-2013, Chapter 10.20 Residential Detached Zone (RD), drafted by an agent from the text of PDF pages 61 to 66 (by-law page numbers 47 to 52). Not a benchmark until a person reviews every rule against the source PDF. source_page is the PDF page number. Each quote occurs on its cited page (scripts/check_draft_gold_quotes.py). Rules whose value comes from an overlay map (HT, ST, a, f, d, lot coverage) are not listed because the value is not in the text. required_rule_terms is left for the reviewer.

rules.applies_to: ambulance depot, fire hall or police station
rules.condition: lot fronts on a street which intersects a major street on the Policy Areas Overlay Map
rules.quote: is no more than 250 metres from that intersection

rules.applies_to: community centre or library
rules.quote: be on a lot with a lot area of 1500 square metres or less

rules.applies_to: community centre or library
rules.condition: lot line abuts a street which intersects a major street on the Policy Areas Overlay Map
rules.quote: within 80.0 metres of that intersection

rules.applies_to: place of worship
rules.quote: a lot area of at least 2,000 square metres

rules.applies_to: place of worship
rules.quote: a lot frontage of at least 30 metres

rules.applies_to: place of worship
rules.condition: does not apply to a lawfully existing place of worship
rules.quote: be in a building with no more than 2,000 square metres of gross floor area

rules.applies_to: lot in the RD zone
rules.condition: zone label has no "f" value on the Zoning By-law Map
rules.quote: the required minimum lot frontage is 12.0 metres

rules.applies_to: building or structure in the RD zone
rules.condition: lot has no numerical value following "HT" on the Height Overlay Map
rules.quote: following the letters "HT" on the Height Overlay Map, 10.0 metres

rules.applies_to: exterior portion of main walls of a detached house
rules.condition: the higher of 7.0 m above established grade or 2.5 m less than the permitted maximum height; applies to the walls listed in 10.20.40.10(2)(A) or (B)
rules.quote: the higher of 7.0 metres above established grade

rules.applies_to: front and rear main walls of a detached house
rules.condition: share of total width subject to the main wall height limit in 10.20.40.10(2)(A)
rules.quote: (A) for no less than 60% of the total width of: (i) all front main walls; and (ii) all rear main walls

rules.applies_to: side main walls of a detached house facing a side lot line that abuts a street
rules.condition: alternative (B) in 10.20.40.10(2)
rules.quote: for no less than 60% of the total width of the side main walls facing a side lot line that abuts a street

rules.applies_to: side main walls of a detached house not facing a side lot line that abuts a street
rules.condition: alternative (B) in 10.20.40.10(2)
rules.quote: for no less than 100% of the total width of the side main walls that do not face a side lot line that abuts a street

rules.applies_to: detached house with a flat or shallow roof
rules.condition: roof slope less than 1.0 vertical per 4.0 horizontal for more than 50% of the total horizontal roof area
rules.quote: the permitted maximum height of the building is 7.2 metres

rules.applies_to: detached house with a flat or shallow roof
rules.condition: roof slope less than 1.0 vertical per 4.0 horizontal for more than 50% of the total horizontal roof area
rules.quote: the building may have no more than two storeys

rules.applies_to: parapet on a detached house with a flat or shallow roof
rules.condition: above the maximum height in 10.20.40.10(4)
rules.quote: by a maximum of 0.3 metres

rules.applies_to: first floor of a building in the RD zone
rules.quote: the permitted maximum height of the first floor above established grade is 1.2 metres

rules.applies_to: dormers on a detached house with two or more storeys
rules.condition: dormer exterior sides are not main walls only within this share of the main wall width on the same side
rules.quote: does not occupy more than 40% of the total width of the building's main walls

rules.applies_to: attic floor area used for mechanical equipment
rules.condition: floor area meets 10.5.40.40(1); such space is then not a storey
